chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"The believer is most rational at the time of his death."

key_terms.أَعْقَلُ: most rational, most aware, possessing the greatest clarity of intellect
key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Al-Sadiq, Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad عليه السلام
key_terms.اَلْمُؤْمِنُ: the believer, one characterized by iman
key_terms.مَوْتِهِ: his death, the moment of dying

ai.seo_question: When is the believer most rational according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the believer reaches a heightened state of awareness and intellect at the moment of death. It points to the gravity of that moment and the clarity that accompanies the believer's final passage.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.346 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The believer is most rational (aware) at the time of their death."
